subject: Class and category of data items and literals
notes: Rule: '2) An elementary data item described with a VALUE clause containing an alphanumeric literal, and without a PICTURE clause.' (cite.py OK). §13.16.3 SR9 a) implies 'PICTURE X(length)' (cite.py --check 13.16.3 OK). SynthesizeImpliedPictures gives such an entry PIC X(len) analyzed by the one PictureAnalyzer, so it becomes category alphanumeric. Probe p4.cob at 2002/2014: '01 A1 VALUE "HELLO".' -> [HELLO], LENGTH 5; subordinate '05 A3 VALUE "XYZ".' composes into its group (LENGTH(G)=4) and MOVE "Q" TO A3 -> 'Q  '; ALL "AB" -> 'AB'. At --std 85 COBOL0900 names the construct. Zero-length literal excluded (SR9) and falls to SR8 per code. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 2002, 2014, 2023 (the VALUE-implied picture of §13.16.3 SR9; 2023 Annex E lists no change; below-2002 absence is the project's version-matrix determination, not derivable from the 2023 text)
